    const rows = yield* sql<{ readonly record: string }>`

compliant:
import { Effect } from "effect"
import * as SqlClient from "effect/unstable/sql/SqlClient"

export interface Subscription {
  readonly id: string
  readonly accountId: string
  readonly targetUrl: string
  readonly eventType: string
  readonly enabled: boolean
  readonly createdAt: string
}

export const initialize = Effect.gen(function*() {
  const sql = yield* SqlClient.SqlClient
  yield* sql`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notification_subscriptions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_url TEXT NOT NULL,
      event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )
  `
})

export const save = (subscription: Subscription) =>
  Effect.gen(function*() {
    const sql = yield* SqlClient.SqlClient
    yield* sql`
      INSERT INTO notification_subscriptions (
        id, account_id, target_url, event_type, enabled, created_at
      )
      VALUES (
        ${subscription.id}, ${subscription.accountId}, ${subscription.targetUrl},
        ${subscription.eventType}, ${subscription.enabled}, ${subscription.createdAt}
      )
      ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
        account_id = EXCLUDED.account_id,
        target_url = EXCLUDED.target_url,
        event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type,
        enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled,
        created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
    `
  })

export const findById = (id: string) =>
  Effect.gen(function*() {
    const sql = yield* SqlClient.SqlClient
    const rows = yield* sql<Subscription>`
      SELECT
        id,
        account_id AS "accountId",
        target_url AS "targetUrl",
        event_type AS "eventType",
        enabled,
        created_at AS "createdAt"
      FROM notification_subscriptions
      WHERE id = ${id}
    `
    return rows[0]
  })
